items.title: Jimmy Wormworth interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 6, 2002
items.q: I used to go up pretty frequently to visit my mother and my aunts and play gigs with J.R. and Sal Nistico.

ctx.x: I’ve been looking forward to this, because you know I’ve heard your name over the years so often, being up in Utica, and you making fortunate trips up there on occasion.
Not lately, but yeah, I used to go up pretty frequently to visit my mother and my aunts and play gigs with J.R. and Sal Nistico.
People talk about, up there anyway, they talk about how Central New York used to be a pretty good music avenue.
